title: Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements: Schedule of Plans, Terms and Price Bands
content:
# Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements — Schedule of Plans

Six plans are written under Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements. Each runs for a fixed term counted in calendar days from the day the agreement is opened, and each is offered only for merchandise whose pre-tax price falls within the plan's price band. The schedule below is the plan-by-plan tariff the counter writes from.

| Plan | Term (calendar days from opening) | Smallest merchandise price (USD, pre-tax) | Largest merchandise price (USD, pre-tax) | Further condition of entry |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30-Day Hold Agreement | 30 | 99.00 | 1999.00 | none |
| 90-Day Layaway | 90 | 299.00 | 7999.00 | none |
| 6-Month Layaway | 180 | 799.00 | 19999.00 | none |
| 12-Month Bridal Layaway | 365 | 1999.00 | 49999.00 | a bridal purchase |
| Special Order Layaway | 120 | 499.00 | 29999.00 | a piece ordered in specially |
| Gift Registry Layaway | 240 | 999.00 | 24999.00 | a gift registry |

## Reading the schedule

1. The term is the number of calendar days the agreement runs for from the day it is opened.
2. The price band is read against the pre-tax price of the merchandise held. A price equal to the plan's smallest merchandise price is within the band, and a price equal to its largest is within the band; a price below the smallest or above the largest is outside it.
3. The 12-Month Bridal Layaway is written only on a bridal purchase, the Special Order Layaway only on a piece ordered in specially, and the Gift Registry Layaway only on an agreement that belongs to a gift registry. The other three plans carry no condition of entry beyond the price band.
4. Every plan also requires a deposit at opening of at least the plan's minimum share of the merchandise price: 10 percent on the 30-Day Hold Agreement, 20 percent on the 90-Day Layaway and the 6-Month Layaway, 25 percent on the 12-Month Bridal Layaway, 50 percent on the Special Order Layaway and 15 percent on the Gift Registry Layaway.

## Illustration on a hypothetical price

Take, hypothetically, a piece priced at 1999.00 before tax that is neither a bridal purchase, a special order nor a registry item. It sits exactly at the top of the 30-Day Hold Agreement band and so is within it; it is within the 90-Day Layaway band and within the 6-Month Layaway band; the 12-Month Bridal Layaway, the Special Order Layaway and the Gift Registry Layaway are closed to it by their conditions of entry whatever the price. Had the same piece been priced at 2000.00, the 30-Day Hold Agreement would no longer admit it.
